messages:
anna: Heads-up 1: I'm doing a small quickstart auth metadata refresh for hello-quick. Goal: switch examples to SDK v8 ephemeral keys, update the GH Actions snippet, and tidy Docker examples (remove env_file). Will touch docs/quickstart/hello-quick.md, snippets/auth.md, and samples/hello-quick. Any concerns?

tom: Sounds good. Please keep a single-file minimal example for copy/paste. The multi-file setup confuses newbies.

priya: Agree on removing env_file. Also add a short "Why ephemeral keys" blurb (non-technical) and a security note: do not log tokens. I can update snippets in snippets/auth.md.

anna: draft rotation helper (docs-only, minimal): function startRotation(getToken, apply){ let stopped=false; async function loop(){ if(stopped) return; const t=await getToken(); apply(t); setTimeout(loop,50*60*1000); } loop(); return { stop: ()=>{ stopped=true } } }

anna: I'll also add a tiny GH Actions mint example showing how to write to GITHUB_ENV and use REDWOOD_API_KEY in next step.

tom: Add the stop handle in code so tests can tear it down. Also add a one-liner migration note for Dedicated/private explaining to use customer KMS for signing mint requests and link to infra runbook. Sales wants that for enablement.

ci-bot: preview build queued for branch quickstart-auth-metadata-refresh  linkcheck: 404 found at /quickstart/hello-old-auth (referenced by TOC).

anna: thanks bot 1, I'll add a redirect and scrub TOC references. Plan: open PR #5011 containing docs + sample app changes and a separate CI example PR. Will tag @docs-team, @eng-security, @eng-platform.

priya: I'll run the sample locally and smoke the GH Actions flow once PRs land.

tom: please include a changelog bullet and a short migration snippet for Dedicated. Otherwise LGTM.

anna: will do. Opening PRs in ~60 minutes and will post links and a short checklist here when ready.
